meta.name: email-quality-auditor
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "audit an email program" or "is this campaign safe to send"; runs a typed 20-item SEND profile with authentication, consent, opt-out, and claim veto checks on own evidence. Not for building deliverability setup — use deliverability-qa; not for designing lifecycle flows — use email-sequence-designer. 邮件质量审计/EQS评分/发送前放行

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计邮件发送质量并生成EQS评分
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责邮件营销并需要发送前质量把关
copy.tagline_en: Audit email send quality and generate EQS score
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage email marketing and need pre-send quality checks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 20 项 SEND 标准审计邮件程序，检查身份验证、用户同意、退订机制和宣传声明，并给出评分和放行/拦截建议。
howto.when: 当你要求审计邮件程序或询问某次发送是否安全时触发。也适用于检查身份验证、同意、退订、投诉、频率、声明或归因。

say.text: 审计这个新闻邮件，用最近90天的数据。
say.note: Claude 会收集证据并运行 SEND 评分。

say.text: 检查这个促销邮件：DMARC、同意记录、退订和声明。
say.note: Claude 会逐项检查关键控制点。

say.text: 给这个邮件程序做一次 EQS 基线评分。
say.note: Claude 会生成完整的 SEND 评分报告。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude audits an email program against 20 SEND criteria, checking authentication, consent, opt-out, and claims, then produces a score and a ship/block/fix verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to audit an email program or ask if a campaign is safe to send. Also when authentication, consent, suppression, complaints, frequency, claims, or attribution need checking.

say_en.text: Audit this newsletter using the last 90 days.
say_en.note: Claude will gather evidence and run SEND scoring.

say_en.text: Check this promotional send: DMARC, consent, opt-out, claims.
say_en.note: Claude will verify each critical control.

say_en.text: Run an EQS baseline on this email program.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a full SEND score report.
